title: National Liberty Museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: At the National Liberty Museum, our dynamic, interactive exhibitions explore liberty in all its forms - its history, its meaning, and its relevance today. Created with scholars, artists, and community partners, each exhibition invites visitors of all backgrounds to engage thoughtfully with the enduring power of freedom. With new exhibitions on view every year, no two NLM experiences are ever the same. Fresh exhibitions, new perspectives, engaging ways to experience liberty - every time you visit. services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: Just steps from Independence Hall and the Liberty Bell, the National Liberty Museum brings liberty to life. Complete your Historic Philadelphia experience with an exploration of First Amendment freedoms and civil liberties in our permanent and featured exhibitions. Whether guided by Museum Educators or exploring on your own, a field trip to the National Liberty Museum empowers students to be civic actors in their own communities. The National Liberty Museum offers a range of civics-based museum programs for students, designed to complement classroom learning and connect seamlessly with visits to other Old City Philadelphia sites. services.name: Awards Programs
services.desc: The National Liberty Museum puts its mission into practice by honoring people of all ages and backgrounds who make a difference in the lives of others. We thank you for your interest in these programs and encourage you to participate. Winners are selected directly from nominations by people like you. Our Young Heroes Award program recognizes young people who have championed liberty through their actions.
